game_title: Countdown Launch – Mine Cart Tunnel Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the count value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the mine cart using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The mine cart reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the mine cart is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Countdown Launch
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
